entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A horror plane menaced by monsters, where humans now lack Avacyn's protection and turn to older, darker magic.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel whose death left Innistrad's humans without her protection.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: The countryside where humans gather deep in the woods.

entities.name: Harvesttide
entities.description: A festival of hope tied to a ritual with warlocks to maintain the balance of day and night.

entities.name: Werewolves
entities.description: Monsters who have gone loony and menace Innistrad's humans.

events.summary: Without Avacyn's protection humans turn to older, darker magic to fend off Innistrad's monsters.
The populace fears a night that may never end, with the sun rising later and setting sooner.
events.quote: Midnight Hunt begins the new story ripped right from the worries of Innistrad's populace: a night that may never end .

events.summary: Humans turn to the Harvesttide festival and a ritual with warlocks to maintain the balance.
events.quote: they turn to the hope of the Harvesttide festival and a ritual with warlocks to maintain the balance.

events.summary: Humans gather deep in the woods of the Kessig countryside amid werewolves and other night denizens.
events.quote: there's strength and hope for the humans gathered deep in the woods of the Kessig countryside.

relations.quote: there's strength and hope for the humans gathered deep in the woods of the Kessig countryside.
